Model weights are the trained parameters stored in the model files, and they define what the AI can do.  
The KV cache is temporary memory that stores key/value vectors from earlier tokens so the model doesn't have to recompute them for every new token.  
Weights stay the same for a given model, while the KV cache changes as you generate more text.  
In practice, weights determine quality, and the KV cache affects speed and memory usage during local runs.
